description: This Java class defines a custom runtime exception, GLAccountInvalidClassificationException, used in the accounting module of the Fineract project to signify invalid classifications for general ledger accounts.

classes.name: GLAccountInvalidClassificationException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an invalid GL account classification usage within the system.

methods.name: GLAccountInvalidClassificationException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an invalid usage code and a message indicating the invalid classification.
